emphasis_points: Emphasize the design details (e.g., headboard style, materials).
Highlight the bed as the centerpiece of the bedroom.
If storage is present, emphasize the practicality and ease of access (e.g., hydraulic lift).
avoid_list: Do not mention mattresses unless specifically recommending a size.
Do not use overly clinical descriptions of the frame.
Do not default to stock mood words: soft, gentle, calm, quiet, peaceful, serene, grounded, restful, tidy, organized. Describe factual material qualities instead.
